_comment: Potter's model policy (ratified T28: Potter-owned selection from validated candidates, hard cost ceilings, no open-ended outside routing such as openrouter/auto). Candidates are the models the previous assistant ran in production: DeepSeek V4 Flash as the default worker, V4 Pro for escalation, Gemini Flash as the fallback, Gemma 4 on the owner's Mac for small local work, and Jev for typed decisions. install/apply_models.py writes the agent classes into OpenClaw; to change a model, edit this file and run that script (or ask Potter).

job_turn.description: Scheduled agent turns. Every agent job names this class; none inherits a session default.

escalation.description: Hard reasoning, used only when the owner asks or a worker is out of its depth.

merrick.description: The house specialist's reasoning path (the fast path needs no model).

local_small.description: Small bounded tasks on the owner's Mac; falls back to the cloud when the Mac is asleep, and says so.

decision.description: Typed decisions (choice, score, yes/no) on the decision endpoint.

kg_curation.description: The knowledge graph curator's decisions (6-hourly command job).
